code: import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync } from "fs";
annotations.comment:
===== 依赖导入 =====
Node.js 文件系统模块：读取、写入、判断存在性、创建目录、读取目录、获取文件状态
子进程模块：同步执行 shell 命令
glob 库：按通配符模式匹配文件路径
路径工具：提取目录名、拼接路径
Anthropic SDK 的类型定义（仅用于类型，不引入运行时依赖）

A tool is three things: a name, a description the model reads, and a function
that does the work. The definitions below are exactly the shape the API wants.
一个工具由三部分组成：名称、模型可读的描述、以及真正干活的函数。
下面的定义结构正是 Anthropic API 所要求的格式。
工具定义表：每个条目声明一个工具的名称、描述和输入参数 schema

code: description: "Read the contents of a file. Returns the file content with line numbers.",
properties: { file_path: { type: "string", description: "The path to the file to read" } },
annotations.comment: read_file：读取文件内容，返回带行号的文本

code: description: "Write content to a file. Creates it if missing, overwrites if it exists.",
file_path: { type: "string", description: "The path to the file to write" },
content: { type: "string", description: "The content to write" },
annotations.comment: write_file：写入文件，不存在则创建，已存在则覆盖

code: description: "Replace an exact string in a file with new content. old_string must match exactly and be unique.",
file_path: { type: "string", description: "The path to the file to edit" },
old_string: { type: "string", description: "The exact string to find" },
new_string: { type: "string", description: "The string to replace it with" },
annotations.comment: edit_file：精确字符串替换；old_string 必须完全匹配且唯一

code: description: "List files matching a glob pattern (e.g. \"**/*.ts\").",
pattern: { type: "string", description: "Glob pattern to match files" },
path: { type: "string", description: "Base directory. Defaults to cwd." },
annotations.comment: list_files：按 glob 模式列出匹配的文件

code: description: "Search for a regex pattern in files. Returns matching lines with paths and line numbers.",
pattern: { type: "string", description: "The regex pattern to search for" },
path: { type: "string", description: "Directory or file to search. Defaults to cwd." },
annotations.comment: grep_search：正则搜索文件内容，返回匹配行及路径和行号

code: description: "Execute a shell command and return its output. For tests, git, package installs, etc.",
properties: { command: { type: "string", description: "The shell command to execute" } },
annotations.comment: run_shell：执行 shell 命令并返回输出（用于跑测试、git、安装依赖等）

code: export async function executeTool(name: string, input: Record<string, any>): Promise<string> {
case "read_file": return readFile(input as { file_path: string });
case "write_file": return writeFile(input as { file_path: string; content: string });
case "edit_file": return editFile(input as { file_path: string; old_string: string; new_string: string });
case "list_files": return listFiles(input as { pattern: string; path?: string });
case "grep_search": return grepSearch(input as { pattern: string; path?: string });
case "run_shell": return runShell(input as { command: string });
annotations.comment:
Dispatch a tool call by name. Unknown names return an error string instead of
throwing, so a hallucinated tool name lets the model self-correct.
按名称分派工具调用。未知的工具名返回错误字符串而非抛出异常，
这样模型面对幻觉出的工具名时可以自行纠错。
工具执行入口：根据工具名路由到对应的实现函数
未知工具：返回提示信息而非报错，交给模型自行修正
读取文件内容，每行加上行号前缀（格式：行号右对齐4位 + " | " + 内容）
读取失败时返回错误信息而非抛异常，让模型能感知到问题

code: function writeFile(input: { file_path: string; content: string }): string {
annotations.comment: 写入文件：如果所在目录不存在则自动创建，然后写入内容
目录不存在时递归创建，避免写入失败
统计写入的行数，在返回信息中告知模型

code: function editFile(input: { file_path: string; old_string: string; new_string: string }): string {
annotations.comment:
edit_file is the one tool with a real trap: the match must be unique, or you
edit the wrong place. So we count occurrences and refuse if it isn't unique.
edit_file 是唯一一个有真正陷阱的工具：匹配必须唯一，否则你会改错地方。
因此我们先统计出现次数，不唯一就拒绝执行。
编辑文件：将文件中唯一匹配的 old_string 替换为 new_string
完全找不到匹配字符串时报错
通过 split 后的段数减一来计算出现次数

code: return `Error: old_string found ${count} times in ${input.file_path}. Must be unique.`;
annotations.comment: 出现多次则拒绝替换，避免歧义性修改

split/join avoids $-substitution surprises from String.replace.
用 split/join 而非 String.replace，避免 $ 替换符带来的意外行为。

code: async function listFiles(input: { pattern: string; path?: string }): Promise<string> {
annotations.comment: 列出匹配 glob 模式的文件（自动排除 node_modules 和 .git）
不返回目录，只返回文件

code: if (files.length === 0) return "No files found matching the pattern.";
annotations.comment: 排除依赖目录和 git 目录，避免噪声
最多返回 200 个结果，防止输出过长

code: function grepSearch(input: { pattern: string; path?: string }): string {
annotations.comment: 正则搜索文件内容：返回匹配行及其路径和行号

Prefer the system grep; fall back to a tiny JS walker if it isn't there.
优先使用系统自带的 grep；如果系统没有 grep，则回退到一个简易的 JS 遍历器。
过滤空行，最多取 100 条匹配结果
grep 退出码 1 表示「无匹配」，属于正常情况，不算错误
其他错误（如 grep 不存在）回退到纯 JS 实现

code: function grepJS(pattern: string, dir: string): string {
annotations.comment: 纯 JS 实现的 grep：递归遍历目录，逐行做正则匹配（grep 不可用时的后备方案）

code: try { re = new RegExp(pattern); } catch (e: any) { return `Error: invalid regex: ${e.message}`; }
annotations.comment: 先编译正则表达式，无效正则直接返回错误
递归遍历目录的内部函数

code: let st; try { st = statSync(full); } catch { continue; }
annotations.comment: 跳过隐藏文件和 node_modules 目录
如果是目录则递归遍历
逐行读取文件内容并做正则匹配
执行 shell 命令并返回输出
命令失败时返回退出码和 stdout/stderr，方便模型诊断问题

code: export async function runCli(argv: string[] = process.argv.slice(2)): Promise<void> {
annotations.comment:
A tiny REPL: read a line, hand it to the agent, repeat. One-shot mode runs a
single prompt from argv and exits (handy for scripts and testing). Exported as
runCli(argv) so it can be driven in-process without spawning a shell.
一个微型 REPL（读取-求值-打印循环）：读取一行输入，交给 agent 处理，然后重复。
单次模式（one-shot）会从命令行参数取一个 prompt 执行一次后退出，
这对脚本和测试很方便。导出为 runCli(argv)，这样无需新开 shell 就能在进程内调用它。
检查是否设置了 API Key，没有就提示并退出
创建 agent 实例，它是处理消息、调用工具的核心对象

code: if (saved) { agent.loadHistory(saved as any); console.log(`(resumed ${saved.length} messages)`); }
annotations.comment:
--resume: reload the saved conversation before doing anything else.
--resume：在开始任何操作前，先把上次保存的对话历史加载回来
把剩余的命令行参数拼成一个一次性的 prompt
把输入交给 agent 进行一次对话
对话结束后保存历史，便于下次 --resume 恢复

code: const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
console.log("mini-claude — type a message, or 'exit' to quit.\n");
annotations.comment: 进入交互式 REPL 模式：从标准输入读、写到标准输出
用一个 Promise 包住整个问答循环，使函数变成可 await 的异步流程
ask() 是一个递归的提问函数：每次回答完后再调用自身，实现循环
输入 exit 或 quit 时关闭输入流并结束循环

annotations.comment: /clear：清空对话历史并保存，然后继续提问
非空输入直接当作普通消息发送给 agent
每轮对话后保存历史

code: const STATIC_CORE = `You are Mini Claude Code, a small coding assistant CLI.
You help with software engineering tasks using the tools available to you.
annotations.comment:
The static core: identity, rules, and tool preferences. Byte-identical across
sessions, which is exactly what makes it cacheable (a real agent marks this
block with cache_control).
静态核心部分：助手的身份、规则以及工具使用偏好。它在不同会话间逐字节相同，
这正是它能被缓存的原因（真实的 agent 会用 cache_control 标记这一段）。

code: - Do not propose changes to code you haven't read. Read files first.
- Do not create files unless necessary. Prefer editing existing files.
- Avoid over-engineering. Only make changes that were requested.
- Prefer reversible actions. For risky or destructive ones (rm -rf, git push,
dropping tables), confirm with the user before proceeding.
- Use read_file / edit_file / list_files / grep_search instead of shell cat,
sed, ls, grep. Reserve run_shell for actual shell operations.
- If several tool calls are independent, make them in parallel.
- Keep responses short and concise. Lead with the answer.

annotations.comment:
The dynamic half: environment facts assembled fresh each run. Kept separate
from the static core so it never pollutes the cache.
动态部分：每次运行时重新收集的环境信息。与静态核心分开存放，
这样它就不会污染（破坏）静态核心的缓存。

code: const opts = { encoding: "utf-8" as const, timeout: 3000, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] as ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] };
const branch = execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD", opts).trim();
annotations.comment: 尝试获取当前 git 分支名；失败则忽略（比如目录不是 git 仓库）
组装环境信息：工作目录、平台架构、默认 shell 以及 git 分支

Static core first, then the environment block.
